rationale: The assistant gave a safe, correctly isolated first step (condenser/filter clean) and stayed well calibrated, naming the pump/hose/float as likely areas without asserting a diagnosis or a part. However it escalated after only two exchanges, skipping the accessible pump-sump compartment clean that the ground truth identifies as the key next step (and which actually improved the fault), and never asked about container seating, the model number, the stacked installation or the musty smell. The engineer referral is the right eventual direction but premature, so a UK homeowner leaves with little actionable progress.
